title: AtomBridge: Agentic VLA Inference Plugin for Long-Horizon Tasks in Scientific Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2602.09430v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Robotic laboratories play a critical role in autonomous scientific discovery by enabling scalable, continuous experimental execution. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models offer a promising foundation for robotic laboratories. However, scientific experiments typically involve long-horizon tasks composed of multiple atomic tasks. Existing VLA models may fail to perform composed tasks formed by reordering and composing these known atomic actions. This limitation can arise from a skill-chaining gap caused by robot-state mismatch: the terminal robot state of one skill can fall outside the valid initial-state distribution of the next. translated_title: AtomBridge：面向科学实验中长时程任务的智能体VLA推理插件
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.09430v2 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：机器人实验室在自主科学发现中扮演关键角色，能够实现可扩展、连续的实验执行。最近的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人实验室提供了有前景的基础。然而，科学实验通常涉及由多个原子任务组成的长时程任务。现有的VLA模型可能无法执行通过重新排序和组合这些已知原子动作而形成的组合任务。这种限制可能源于由机器人状态不匹配导致的技能链接缺口：一个技能的终端机器人状态可能落在下一个技能的合法初始状态分布之外。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了AtomBridge，一种用于科学实验中长时程任务的智能体VLA推理插件。AtomBridge在推理时附加到一个已在原子任务上微调的VLA策略上，同时保持其权重固定。在每个任务边界，它使用基于LLM的转换器来弥合状态缺口，确保平滑的技能过渡。
tldr: AtomBridge是一种推理时插件，通过利用LLM在任务边界调整机器人状态，解决VLA模型在长时程科学实验中的技能链接缺口问题，无需重新训练模型权重。
en_tdlr: AtomBridge is an inference-time plugin that addresses the skill-chaining gap in VLA models for long-horizon scientific experiments by using LLM-based state adjustment at task boundaries, without retraining model weights.
